name: Gobō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Gobō city emblem in white: a triangular device of three curved strokes around a centre.
history: Municipal flag of Gobō, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1954.

features.role: Gobō city emblem — a triangular device of three curved strokes around a centre
